objective: At the owner's request ('Yep, let's do it. Please get started.', approving the proposal made after their question about a number line or Cartesian plane whose axes are infinite structures of logic): study bond distance, the size of the smallest knot through two distinctions minus one (NATIVE-NETWORK-20261021-001), on infinite uniform laws and on laws grown with nothing drawn. Serves question 9 (space from a law) with question 7 (limits). Standalone value relative to the nearest known work: symbolic dynamics knows strong irreducibility and the non-mixing shapes of Ledrappier's shift, and Wolfram-style rewriting measures dimension by ball growth in a drawn hypergraph; neither measures distance by the minimal constraints of the allowed states. A: no ends (dense finite moves, or strong irreducibility) makes bond distance a ruler, linear in separation, so bond balls grow polynomially with the lattice's dimension; one bit per site forces frozen parity laws; per-variable nativity is not enough. B: in Ledrappier's frozen law far points share small knots: bond size 3 exactly at power-of-two separations, at most 2 + (signed-binary digit count) in general, so bond balls are infinite. C: substitution towers of knots with nothing drawn: conservative rules never stretch the ruler; which rules stretch it, and what growth dimension (log copies / log stretch) results.
status: Complete 2026-11-07: the axis built from logic. Without ends bond distance is a ruler: splitting laws have chained knots, the gauge and Tseitin lattices read their dimension from allowed states (taxicab on the plane), and the atom thread is an exact number line (bond distance = loops between + 1). Ledrappier's frozen law measures its axes in signed bits (size-3 knots are Frobenius triangles; bond distance <= 1 + NAF weight; conjecture: equality). Growth that keeps old allowed states never stretches; with nothing drawn, substitution towers stretch exactly when they add open ends (proved for hub-free gadgets), with dimension log(copies)/log(stretch) fixed by the chosen gadget (1.26, 1.63, 1.29 measured). Per-variable nativity does not give a ruler (correction request: natively bound knots). Next: Continue (2/3), growth at open ends.
stop_rule: Stop when A and B are proved or obstructed with explicit counterexamples, and C has classified a bounded census of substitution rules by conservation, stretch and growth dimension, or found an executable obstruction to measuring them.
title: The axis built from logic: bond distance as a law grows to infinity
